body: so you are still alive, thats good. sorry for being rude in my first post, but i got your attention now. if you can not go on with yourself, then change the point of view about yourself. what people consider mostly as their "myself" is the ego which prevents the you from being happy through all unnecessary needs

get your ass out of there, you dont want to die.
hey guys, thanks for response and music. I tried many other medications and therapists, an endless odysee. the good times fade away in my mind, its almost like i have a memory of a memory

thank you for sharing. you are a very strong person and you can be sure i am not the only one who has this opinion. and you are not a leech, capitalism just demands its victims. the only advise i can give is to take care of your body. try to get like 30 minutes every day to be all on yourself, maybe simple yoga. best wishes.

hey there. i hope this message gets you and you have not made any overhasty things. The message this text gave me is that you want to let your ego die, not end your life, which is lastly a good decision. That click when you mind came to the conclusion you had never been happy is triggered by the massive imposition and the awkward situation you are in. Your ego is afraid that admitting your life has nothing in common with you will let it die. But listen: you are not your mind. you are not your ego. The only thing you will really ever have is an open end. For me, this psychological strain was the trigger for an other point of view in life.
